snippet.title: Let's Play GBA 762: Scan Hunter (J)
snippet.description: I kind of like this. It's basically a sci-fi/anime version of a fishing game. Instead of trying to catch fish, we're trying to "scan" them. I dunno why, but I think it makes for some interesting creative options available. Who knows what the game might hold?
